question: How many instances are both in availability zone 'flare3' (with the max system-metadata ID over the current and next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID) and in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' (with cached network info and an availability-zone rank)? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH flare3_window AS (
  SELECT 
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    MAX(s.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_sm_id_window
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata s ON s.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
),
shelved_offloaded_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.availability_zone ORDER BY i.uuid) AS az_rank
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
    AND c.network_info IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS instance_count
FROM flare3_window fw
JOIN shelved_offloaded_ranked sor ON fw.instance_uuid = sor.instance_uuid;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT i.uuid,
         MAX(s.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_sm_id
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata s ON s.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
) t
JOIN instances i2 ON i2.uuid = t.uuid
JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i2.uuid
WHERE i2.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
  AND c.network_info IS NOT NULL
  AND i2.availability_zone IS NOT NULL;

  SELECT 
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.availability_zone,
    i.vm_state,
    ism.id AS system_metadata_id,
    iic.network_info
  FROM instances i
  INNER JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  INNER JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
    AND iic.network_info IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT 
    instance_uuid,
    system_metadata_id,
    MAX(system_metadata_id) OVER (ORDER BY instance_uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_sys_meta_id_window,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY availability_zone ORDER BY instance_uuid) AS az_rank
  FROM base_instances
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS instance_count
FROM windowed
WHERE system_metadata_id = max_sys_meta_id_window
  AND az_rank IS NOT NULL;
